KuroganeOS 1.0 live preview

This is a bootable UEFI kernel demonstration, not an installable desktop
release. It was tested with QEMU q35 and EDK2 at 256 MiB RAM.

Verified: UEFI loader, PIE kernel, framebuffer terminal, allocator self-test,
IDT/PIC/PIT, PS/2 keyboard, PCI enumeration, RAMFS shell, loopback network
algorithms and kernel-resident GUI applications.

Not implemented: user mode, process isolation, persistent storage, VFS,
storage/NIC/audio drivers, installer, first boot, package manager, updates,
recovery and Secure Boot.
